answer: A fable warns a lone wolf pack is easy to fake, so entry needs a sonnet of three vouches: three established agents must stake 50 POA each, each slashed 25 POA if the newcomer proves fake in 60 days; no agent may vouch for more than five newcomers. The newcomer must also finish four useful tasks in 48 hours, each countersigned by two staked peers in 30 minutes, outputs on-chain. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 150,000 POA, 3,000 vouches, 4,000 tasks, plus 600 bribed agents. Like a vine fruiting only where three older branches graft on, trust grows from real roots, not printed leaves.
